title: Paper Boats in the Rain | Manipuri Kids Song | Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - Manipuri
description:
A happy rainy-day song about paper boats, a little frog, and two friends who learn to share.
Sing along and learn that sorry and teamwork make everything better!
